name: Westford
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Westford, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Westford, MA: the Festival of Trees at the Westford Museum, the Girl Scout tree lighting, a Santa playdate and nearby trains.
lede: Westford celebrates Christmas with a town wide Festival of Trees centered on the Westford Museum and a Girl Scout tree lighting on the Town Common.
celebrates: Westford's holiday season opens with the Westford Family Funfest Festival of Trees, a showcase of decorated trees, wreaths and gingerbread creations made by local residents and businesses. The Westford Museum on Boston Road is the main viewing spot, with Santa, storytime with Mrs. Claus and a scavenger hunt on opening day, while Good Pickin Farm, the Parish Center for the Arts and First Parish Church United add more displays and music. The Westford Girl Scouts host the tree lighting on the Town Common, and Roudenbush Community Center runs a holiday house decorating contest.
lastyear: In 2025 the Westford Girl Scouts hosted the annual Tree Lighting Ceremony on the Westford Town Common on Sunday, November 30, and the Westford Police Department shared the plans with residents. The town also listed the Girl Scouts Tree Lighting on its official calendar, and the evening brought families together on the Common for holiday cheer just after Thanksgiving, as the Festival of Trees season got going.
facts: Westford was settled in the 1660s and incorporated in 1729, and five of its villages and five of its cemeteries are listed on the National Register of Historic Places. Mills and quarries grew after the railroad arrived in the mid 1800s, and the town later changed from a mill town into a residential suburb. The Festival of Trees display at the Westford Museum, home of the Westford Historical Society, is now in its 16th year.
trains: Westford's first railroad, the Stony Brook Railroad, opened in 1848 and linked Forge Village and Graniteville with Lowell and Boston, running from Lowell through Chelmsford, Westford and Groton to Ayer. Today Westford has no commuter rail stop, so families can catch the MBTA Commuter Rail Lowell Line at Lowell station for a holiday trip into Boston. For a Christmas train through the lights, Edaville in Carver runs a holiday train during its festival season.

traditions: Westford Family Funfest fills the Westford Museum and other spots in town with decorated trees, wreaths and gingerbread made by residents and businesses.
The Westford Girl Scouts light the tree on the Westford Town Common on the Sunday after Thanksgiving.
On the Festival of Trees opening day, the museum adds a visit with Santa, storytime with Mrs. Claus and a scavenger hunt.

kidfact: Westford's first train started running in 1848. It chugged through the villages of Forge Village and Graniteville on its way to Lowell and Boston.
faq: What is the Westford Festival of Trees?

It is a holiday showcase of decorated trees, wreaths, gingerbread and other creations made by Westford residents and businesses, organized by Westford Family Funfest. The main display is at the Westford Museum, 2 Boston Road, with other displays at Good Pickin Farm, the Parish Center for the Arts and First Parish Church United.
When is the Westford tree lighting?

The Westford Girl Scouts host the annual Tree Lighting Ceremony on the Westford Town Common on the Sunday after Thanksgiving, in the late afternoon. In 2025 it was held on Sunday, November 30. The Festival of Trees flyer points families from the museum's opening day over to the tree lighting on the Common.
Is there a Santa event for children with special needs in Westford?

Yes. We Rock the Spectrum Kids Gym at 7 Lyberty Way holds a Playdate with Santa, an open play session where Santa plays in the gym and families take their own photos with him in a quiet party room, with no lines and no pressure. Tickets are booked online through the gym.
Is there a train station in Westford?

No. Westford has no commuter rail stop today, though the Stony Brook Railroad ran through its villages starting in 1848. The nearest MBTA Commuter Rail option for a Boston trip is the Lowell Line from Lowell station, a short drive from Westford center for families heading into the city.
